interpretation: Exact optimization of local-Max does not improve held-out DLM fidelity over greedy Role.
Global Minimax improves held-out DLM fidelity despite worse GSM8K mini, demonstrating objective mismatch.
Role-separated interventions reveal distinct masked/unmasked causal routes, but do not identify a uniquely valid aggregation rule.
Dense-background additive projection effects can change direction in a jointly sparse background.
next: Develop and audit a cheap sparse-context exchange utility and distinguish DLM fidelity from task-capability preservation before further downstream method sweeps.
